fields.text: If 5 cleaners can clean 5 rooms in 5 hours, how many hours will 10 cleaners take to clean 10 rooms, working at the same rate?
fields.explanation: One cleaner cleans 1 room in 5 hours. Doubling both the cleaners and the rooms keeps each cleaner's share at 1 room, so it still takes 5 hours.
fields.steps:
1. Rate per cleaner: 5 rooms ÷ (5 cleaners × 5 h) = 1/5 room per cleaner per hour.
2. 10 cleaners clean 10 × 1/5 = 2 rooms per hour.
3. Time for 10 rooms: 10 ÷ 2 = 5 hours.
fields.stepsTl:
1. Rate ng isang cleaner: 5 rooms ÷ (5 cleaners × 5 h) = 1/5 room kada oras.
2. Ang 10 cleaners ay 10 × 1/5 = 2 rooms kada oras.

fields.text: If 9 gardeners can plant 9 trees in 9 hours, how many hours will 3 gardeners take to plant 3 trees, working at the same rate?
fields.explanation: One gardener plants 1 tree in 9 hours. With 3 gardeners and 3 trees, each still plants 1 tree, so it takes 9 hours.
fields.steps:
1. Rate per gardener: 9 trees ÷ (9 gardeners × 9 h) = 1/9 tree per gardener per hour.
2. 3 gardeners plant 3 × 1/9 = 1/3 tree per hour.
3. Time for 3 trees: 3 ÷ 1/3 = 9 hours.
